purpose: Present consumer-supplied before/after comparison rows without computing diff meaning or owning audit policy.
useWhen: a review or editor needs readable before/after comparison
the consumer already owns diff computation and version meaning
avoidWhen: the UI needs a full editor engine or merge workflow
a normal table or single value is enough
accessibility: Uses a semantic comparison table with row headers and before/after column headers.
Exposes added, removed, modified, and context meaning as text instead of color alone.
Keeps the comparison bounded and keyboard-scrollable at narrow widths.
responsive: Supports inline and split presentations so consumers can choose a readable narrow layout.
Allows long values to wrap or scroll without widening the route.
motion: Has no required motion; state transitions remain readable without animation.
Respects reduced motion through the shared token contract.

api.name: emptyMessage
api.description: Message shown when the consumer supplies no rows.
